name: Mace MFG
old_description: In 2023, I took a leap of faith and founded Mace Manufacturing. My tinkering on nights and weekends began with 3D printers and CNC routers. This eventually evolved into acquiring a CNC plasma table to design and fabricate a replacement floor for my 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser. As most of you know, as we get older, our tools just get bigger and more expensive. In February of 2023, I decided to sell my dream car, which was a 1993 Nissan Skyline GTR, to purchase a HAAS VF2 and challenge myself to develop unique and innovative automotive machined accessories.
about:
Mace MFG is based in Indian Land, South Carolina. Founded in 2023 by Stuart, a mechanical engineer, the company began as a nights-and-weekends project using 3D printers and CNC routers. After fabricating a replacement floor for a 1974 Toyota Land Cruiser with a CNC plasma table, Stuart sold a 1993 Nissan Skyline GT-R in February 2023 to purchase a HAAS VF2 vertical machining center, committing full-time to producing machined automotive accessories.

The shop focuses on precision-machined accessories for off-road Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Using the HAAS VF2 alongside 3D printing and CNC plasma cutting, Mace MFG produces billet aluminum volume knobs (marketed as "Knobbies"), titanium-and-Ultem key fob cases, battery tie-downs, shift knobs, front bump stops, rail T-nuts, and battery clamp J-hooks. Materials include 6061 aluminum, titanium, Ultem (PEI), and polycarbonate. The product line spans multiple SKUs across 4Runner, Tundra, Tacoma, Sequoia, GX, LX, and FJ Cruiser models.

The company serves the automotive aftermarket, specifically off-road and overlanding enthusiasts driving Toyota and Lexus trucks and SUVs. Customers purchase directly through the Mace MFG web store; notable community figures such as Keith Charvonia of Charvonia Design, Patrick Perry of Perry Parts, and Colten Johnson of Teton Workshop are featured as collaborators.

Mace MFG emphasizes American manufacturing and engineering-driven design, stating that every detail is scrutinized to deliver quality without compromise. The founder's background in automotive design and manufacturing informs a philosophy of "innovation drives us" and "from our hands to yours."
